description: local-ollama.json with an older Qwen as coder A, to compare models on the same responses. Every role on models served by Ollama on this machine: no key, no cost, no respondent text leaves the machine (ADR-0049). Coder A qwen2.5:7b-instruct (Alibaba), coder B, the judge and the refactorer gemma4:12b (Google). Pull first: ollama pull qwen2.5:7b-instruct gemma4:12b embeddinggemma
